judged_text: URL validation is split across two components with different semantics: EmbedController#best (embed_controller.rb:15) accepts any embed_url as long as the referer host matches embeddable_host, while TopicRetriever#invalid_host? silently drops any embed_url whose own host differs from embeddable_host. An embeddable page pointing the iframe at an article on a different host renders the loading page and re-enqueues a retrieve_topic job on every 30-second reload forever — the job no-ops on the host check before the throttle is even set, so the visitor sees 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely with no error signal and the job queue absorbs repeated no-op work per viewer.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: EmbedController#best only validates `request.referer` host in `ensure_embeddable` and does not validate `params[:embed_url]` host before enqueueing `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, embed_url: embed_url)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). TopicRetriever#retrieve short-circuits on `invalid_host?` (lib/topic_retriever.rb): if `URI(@embed_url).host` differs from `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, it returns without calling `retrieved_recently?`, so no throttle key is set. Meanwhile `loading.html.erb` reloads every 30s and each request will enqueue another job because the embed is never created, leading to indefinite loading plus repeated no-op jobs.
